title: Encyclopaedia Britannica - Sixth edition, Volume 6, CHI-Crystallization - EB.11
text: Lastly, the cloth being taken out of the press, and the papers,&c for glossing it removed, it is in a condition or rate or use. This regard to the manufacture of mask clothes, or those whether the woods are first dyed, and then mixst, spun, and wove of the co- loure intended, the process, except what relates to the colors is mostly the same with that just represented.
